title: land of a code-lane item waits for its merge request without --wait-merge being named
goal: backlog.py land of an item whose commits are code-lane waits for the merge request by default (the skill's --wait-merge 1800), and --wait-merge 0 keeps today's push-and-stop, so a landing run without the flag does not stop after the push and need a second run (ST-zezjnwe6 of SP-ysuvdxsn)

run:
import subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','land','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True)
t=' '.join(p.stdout.split());print(t[t.find('--wait-merge'):][:160]);sys.exit(0 if 'default: 1800' in t or 'default 1800' in t else 1)
